seo.title: Bar Hop in Savannah (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the best bar hop in Savannah for 2026 — curated picks with maps, hours, and insider tips.

hero.h1: Stroll Savannah's live oak squares with open-container cocktails, popping into storied dive bars, jazz lounges, and speakeasies.
hero.subtitle: Experience Savannah's legendary hospitality and unique bar scene, from historic dives to hidden gems, all while enjoying a leisurely stroll with your favorite open-container beverage.

picks.name: Alley Cat Lounge
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tucked away in a historic basement, Alley Cat Lounge is a true speakeasy experience. With an extensive, newspaper-style menu and expert mixologists, it's the perfect spot for bespoke cocktails in an intimate, dimly lit setting. It's known for its commitment to classic cocktail traditions with a modern twist.
picks.whatToOrder: Any classic cocktail expertly crafted, or ask the bartender for a personalized recommendation based on your preferences.
picks.insiderTip: Go early or be prepared to wait; this popular spot fills up quickly, especially on weekends. Look for the discreet entrance in the alley.
picks.redditQuote: "Alley Cat Lounge is hands down the best cocktail bar in Savannah. The bartenders at Alley Cat really know their stuff, and the atmosphere is just perfect for a hidden gem."

picks.name: The Original Pinkie Master's Lounge
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A Savannah institution, Pinkie Master's is the quintessential dive bar, famous for its unpretentious vibe, cheap drinks, and storied past. It's a place where locals and tourists alike rub shoulders, enjoying a no-frills good time. Expect lively conversations and a true taste of old Savannah.
picks.whatToOrder: A cold PBR or a simple shot and a beer combo.
picks.insiderTip: Cash is often king here, though they do accept cards. Don't expect fancy, just good company and strong pours.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want a real Savannah dive experience, you have to hit Pinkie Master's. It's sticky, loud, and perfect."

picks.name: The Rail Pub
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Housed in a former bordello and known for its vibrant live music scene, The Rail Pub is another beloved Savannah dive bar. It offers a fantastic patio, pool tables, and a constant rotation of local bands, making it a lively stop on any bar crawl. The history seeps from its walls.
picks.whatToOrder: A local draft beer or a classic well drink.
picks.insiderTip: Check their schedule for live music nights; the atmosphere gets electric. The patio is a great spot to people-watch.
picks.redditQuote: "The Rail Pub always has a good vibe and solid cheap drinks. Their patio is fantastic on a nice evening in Savannah."

picks.name: Congress Street Up
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located above The Public Kitchen & Bar, Congress Street Up is an elegant speakeasy offering a sophisticated escape. It boasts an impressive selection of whiskeys and masterfully crafted classic cocktails in a plush, intimate setting. This is the spot for a refined drink and quiet conversation.
picks.whatToOrder: An Old Fashioned, a French 75, or explore their extensive whiskey list.
picks.insiderTip: It's a small space, so arrive early for a seat. Dress code is smart casual.
picks.redditQuote: "Congress Street Up makes some of the best cocktails I've ever had. It's a perfect date spot if you're looking for something a bit classier."

picks.name: The Olde Pink House Restaurant & Tavern (Planters Tavern)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While The Olde Pink House is a renowned restaurant, its basement bar, Planters Tavern, offers a cozy and historic drinking experience. With exposed brick, a fireplace, and often live piano music, it's an atmospheric spot for a drink, especially on a cooler evening. It’s a step back in time.
picks.whatToOrder: A mint julep or a glass of wine, enjoying the live piano music if available.
picks.insiderTip: You don't need a dinner reservation to visit the tavern. It's a great place for a pre-dinner drink or a nightcap.
picks.redditQuote: "Planters Tavern in The Olde Pink House is just pure Savannah charm. Grabbing a drink there feels so historic."

picks.name: Savoy Society
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A chic and modern cocktail bar in the trendy Starland District, Savoy Society brings a touch of Art Deco elegance to Savannah. They specialize in beautifully presented craft cocktails and offer a menu of delicious small plates. It's a vibrant spot with a sophisticated yet approachable atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Try one of their rotating seasonal cocktails or a perfectly executed classic.
picks.insiderTip: Pair your drink with some of their small plates; the food menu is surprisingly good.
picks.redditQuote: "Savoy Society has such a cool vibe and their cocktails are seriously next level. Always a great time when I visit."

picks.name: The Ordinary Pub
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Don't let the name fool you; The Ordinary Pub is anything but. Located in a stylish basement, it offers an elevated gastropub experience with inventive brunch, dinner, and a fantastic bar program. Their craft cocktails are a highlight, complementing a lively yet cozy atmosphere perfect for a night out.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature Bloody Mary if you're there for brunch, or an Old Fashioned in the evening.
picks.insiderTip: They often have late-night happy hour specials on cocktails and small bites.
picks.redditQuote: "The Ordinary Pub's basement bar has some surprisingly good cocktails, and their brunch is legendary."

picks.name: Jazz'd Tapas Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For a true jazz lounge experience, Jazz'd Tapas Bar offers live jazz music nightly in a sophisticated setting. Enjoy a diverse menu of tapas and a carefully curated selection of wines and cocktails. It's an intimate venue perfect for a romantic evening or a refined night out.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic martini or a glass of wine, paired with a selection of their delicious tapas.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends, as seating for the live music fills up fast.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want live jazz and good food in Savannah, Jazz'd is the place. The ambiance is just perfect."

picks.name: Wet Willie's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A Savannah staple on River Street, Wet Willie's is famous for its vibrant selection of frozen daiquiris, available in a rainbow of flavors and strengths. It's the ultimate spot to grab a fun, open-container friendly drink before strolling along the river or through the squares. Perfect for a warm day.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Call a Cab' if you dare, or mix a couple of flavors for a personalized blend.
picks.insiderTip: Pace yourself; these frozen drinks are stronger than they taste. They offer samples to help you choose.
picks.redditQuote: "You can't go to River Street without getting a huge frozen daiquiri from Wet Willie's. It's practically a rite of passage."

picks.name: The Peregrin
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched atop the Perry Lane Hotel, The Peregrin offers breathtaking panoramic views of Savannah, including its iconic cityscape and river. This elegant rooftop bar is perfect for sunset cocktails, providing a sophisticated atmosphere with expertly crafted drinks and comfortable lounge seating. It's an ideal starting or ending point for your evening stroll.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing spritz or a sparkling wine, enjoying the sunset views.
picks.insiderTip: Arrive before sunset to secure a good spot for the best views.
picks.redditQuote: "The views from The Peregrin are incredible, especially at sunset. It's a bit pricey but totally worth it for the experience."

picks.name: Bar Julian
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 10th floor of the Thompson Savannah hotel, Bar Julian provides stunning views of the Savannah River and the city skyline. This sophisticated rooftop bar features a Mediterranean-inspired menu and an excellent selection of wines, beers, and innovative cocktails. It offers a chic and vibrant atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Their 'Julian Spritz' or a signature cocktail from their seasonal menu.
picks.insiderTip: Explore the Eastern Wharf area before or after your visit for a different perspective of Savannah.
picks.redditQuote: "Bar Julian has such a sleek, modern vibe and fantastic cocktails. It's a great spot for a fancy drink by the water."

picks.name: Moon River Brewing Company
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While primarily a brewpub, Moon River offers a unique experience with its historic building and famously haunted reputation. Enjoy a range of house-brewed beers in their casual bar area or spacious outdoor beer garden. It's a great place to grab a pint and soak in some local history, with plenty of outdoor space suitable for an open-container pit stop.
picks.whatToOrder: A sampler flight of their house brews or their popular 'Apparition Ale'.
picks.insiderTip: Ask the staff about the ghost stories; they have plenty of chilling tales.
picks.redditQuote: "Moon River is a must-stop, not just for the good beer but for the haunted history. It's always a good time there."

faq.question: Can I really walk around Savannah with an open container?
faq.answer: Yes, Savannah allows open containers of alcoholic beverages in its Historic District. Drinks must be in a plastic cup no larger than 16 ounces. This policy makes it perfect for strolling between squares and bars, enhancing the city's relaxed and social atmosphere.

faq.question: What's the best time of year to visit Savannah for a bar crawl?
faq.answer: Spring (March-May) and Fall (September-November) are ideal. The weather is pleasant for walking, and the city's squares are in full bloom or showcasing beautiful fall foliage. Summers can be very hot and humid, though frozen drinks offer a good reprieve.

faq.question: Are Savannah's speakeasies hard to find?
faq.answer: Some speakeasies in Savannah are intentionally discreet, adding to their allure. Look for subtle signs, unmarked doors, or ask locals for directions. Venues like Alley Cat Lounge and Congress Street Up reward those who seek them out with unique experiences.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for jazz lounges in Savannah?
faq.answer: For popular jazz lounges like Jazz'd Tapas Bar, especially on weekends or evenings with specific live acts, reservations are highly recommended. This ensures you get a good seat and can fully enjoy the music and ambiance without waiting.

faq.question: What are the common price ranges for drinks in Savannah's bars?
faq.answer: Drink prices vary widely depending on the establishment. Dive bars typically offer drinks for $4-10 USD, while craft cocktails at speakeasies or upscale bars range from $12-20 USD. Frozen daiquiris are usually around $10-14 USD.

faq.question: Are Savannah's dive bars safe for tourists?
faq.answer: Generally, Savannah's dive bars are welcoming and safe. Like any urban area, it's wise to be aware of your surroundings, especially late at night. Stick to populated areas and consider using ride-sharing services if you've had a few drinks.

methodology: Our selections for Savannah's best strolling and drinking spots were meticulously researched, focusing on venues celebrated for their unique atmosphere, quality beverages, historical significance, and local popularity. We prioritized establishments that align with Savannah's open-container policy, offering a mix of authentic dive bars, sophisticated speakeasies, and engaging jazz lounges.
